title: Audit the 'Junk Drawer' and Storage Closets
description: Gather every unused phone, dormant tablet, legacy camera, and obsolete gadget sitting in dark drawers. Group them by working vs. non-working condition.
impact: Uncovers dormant value and prevents forgotten battery swelling

title: Untangle, Test, and Bundle Peripherals & Cables
description: Sort accumulated AC adapters, USB cords, display cables, and mice. Match power bricks with correct voltages, wrap cords with velcro ties, and separate frayed wiring.
impact: Prevents redundant purchasing of duplicate accessories

title: Perform a Physical Battery Hazard Inspection
description: Inspect older laptops, portable gaming devices, and phones for swollen backplates, deformed cases, or screen separation. Segregate any compromised cells into fire-safe containers.
impact: Critical fire prevention for household and waste handling

title: Establish a Dedicated Home E-Waste Drop Box
description: Designate a sturdy box or container in your home or garage labeled 'E-Waste / Certified Recycling'. Accumulate dead cells and broken accessories here instead of tossing them in bins.

title: Consolidate Backups Using the 3-2-1 Strategy
description: Ensure your personal photos, documents, and creative work exist in three copies, on two distinct physical media formats, with one copy safely off-site or cloud-encrypted.
impact: Enables risk-free device resetting without data panic

title: Audit Startup Applications and Dormant Software
description: Review Task Manager (Windows) or Activity Monitor (macOS) to disable background utilities launching at boot. Uninstall heavy programs you haven't opened in six months.
impact: Restores system responsiveness and reduces memory pressure

title: Purge Redundant Downloads and Duplicate Screenshots
description: Clear out massive cached downloads, temporary video renders, and duplicate screenshots taking up internal flash storage. Maintain 15%–20% free drive capacity.

title: Audit Passwords and Two-Factor Authentication Tokens
description: Confirm all password manager vaults and authenticator apps (TOTP seeds) are synchronized with a secondary verified device before initiating hardware handoffs.
impact: Prevents catastrophic lockouts during device transitions

title: Check Battery Wear Before Shopping for Upgrades
description: Check the battery health percentage in your OS settings. If maximum capacity is above 80%, sluggish behavior is typically software-related, not dying hardware.
impact: Counteracts planned obsolescence and marketing conditioning

title: Blow Out Thermal Dust from Fans and Heat Pipes
description: Use short bursts of compressed air to clear lint and dust carpets from intake vents. Keep fan blades steady to prevent over-spinning.
impact: Lowers operating temperatures by 10°C–15°C and ends throttling

title: Price Independent Repairs Using the 50% Rule
description: Before replacing a device with a broken screen or weak battery, get a quote from a local repair shop or community repair cafe. If repair is under 50% of replacement value, fix it.
impact: Saves money and prevents unnecessary upstream manufacturing emissions

title: Clear Compacted Lint from USB-C and Lightning Ports
description: If your device won't charge or cables fall out, gently extract compacted pocket fuzz using a non-conductive wooden or plastic toothpick under good lighting.
impact: Fixes 80% of 'broken port' issues with zero cost

title: Sign Out of Ecosystem Accounts and Disable Activation Locks
description: Explicitly disable Apple Find My (Activation Lock), Google Account FRP (Factory Reset Protection), and Microsoft Account device locks before wiping.
impact: Ensures donated hardware is usable by next owner rather than e-waste brick

title: Execute Hardware Factory Reset with Cryptographic Wipe
description: Trigger the official operating system factory reset, opting to clean drives thoroughly. This destroys internal AES cryptographic storage keys permanently.
impact: Zero chance of personal data recovery by future recipients

title: Physically Eject SIM Trays and MicroSD Memory Cards
description: Use an ejector tool or paperclip to open card slots. Physically remove cellular SIM cards and high-capacity flash memory cards before packaging.
impact: Prevents accidental leakage of phone numbers and private photos

title: Verify Recycler Holds R2v3 or e-Stewards Certification
description: Check the official recycler directory to verify third-party certifications ensuring strict environmental standards and zero uncertified overseas scrap dumping.
